workshops.title: To make an Electromagnet
workshops.description: Students will build a simple electromagnet by wrapping wire around an iron nail and connecting it to a battery, learning how electricity creates magnetic fields. All materials are provided.

workshops.title: Ice-Cream in a Bag
workshops.description: In this workshop, students will make ice cream in a bag. Students will shake the bag and watch as a liquid mixture transforms into a frozen treat. Along the way, they will learn how freezing, heat transfer, and salt work together to make ice cream.

workshops.title: Sample: Intro to Block Coding
workshops.description: Kids create their first game with drag-and-drop code.
